property_summary: For any caller and any value, the reference contract C allows the Owner to call Command forwarding msg.value to the callee (the call succeeds or fails as callee dictates) while the mutant rejects any nonzero msg.value; thus the reference never forces msg.value==0 but the mutant does, so there exist inputs (nonzero value from Owner to a reverter callee) that make the mutant revert whereas the reference proceeds to attempt the call and update balances accordingly.
change_summary: Add a require preventing any value from being sent by requiring msg.value == 0 before performing the call with forwarded value (thus reverting if value provided).
